gpt.text:
You’re set up cleanly: you have a current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`), no PASS candidates, nothing inconclusive, and a 3-command queue to (1) run AUB module sweep + select best, (2) run system-level candidates, and (3) generate a “next fix” report.

## What to do next (recommended order)
Run exactly the three commands you listed, in that order:

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## What each command will produce / update
1) **`aub_autopilot.py … --select-best`**
- Runs module-level experiments from `module_registry.yaml`.
- Chooses the best-performing candidate vs the current champion (and typically writes/updates a “best candidate” artifact somewhere under `baseline/` or the experiment output directory, depending on your tooling).
- Since you currently have **no PASS candidates**, this is the step most likely to generate one.

2) **`system_autopilot.py …`**
- Runs system-level candidate configurations from `system_candidates.yaml`.
- This can uncover wins that don’t show up at module level (interactions, end-to-end effects).

3) **`aub_next_fix.py …`**
- Generates `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`, usually summarizing:
  - Which modules repeatedly fail/regress
  - Suggested next targeted fixes
  - Pointers to the most promising candidates / parameters

## Notes on the metrics you pasted
- Champion tuning: mean/min `1.9038 / 0.4315`
- Champion lockbox: mean/min `1.7925 / 1.1337`

Without knowing whether “higher is better” in your scoring, I won’t interpret directionality—but when you review new runs, make sure you compare **lockbox** first for selection stability (tuning gains that don’t translate can be misleading).

## If you want, paste back:
- The console summary from the first autopilot run (or the produced report paths), and I can help you decide whether the selected-best candidate is actually robust enough to promote to champion, or if it looks like an overfit/inconclusive.
